_comment: GH#324 A/B — THE dead-render repro, kept as a live regression capture. A talk_pool bark interacted at world_ready+0 vs +90 idle frames, same NPC, same run. BEFORE the fix, shot 01 was an empty line slot while ui_dialogue_rendered carried the full string (three maps, pre-existing); the cause was NOT rendering but the evidence boundary — a transient panel's windowed-QA hold is a 0.4s wall-clock floor while a capture settles 0.15s PLUS up to 3s of live-tween drain (#119), and the boot music crossfade (1.0s) reliably pushed the capture past the floor. Measured on this very script: settle 817ms at world_ready+0 vs 226ms at +90, against a 400ms hold. test_driver now holds transient panels while a capture is in flight (TestDriver.capture_in_flight), so BOTH legs render. `assert_dialogue_displayed` is the assertion half — it reads message_layer's live panel state at capture time, so a regression fails loud instead of quietly shipping an empty PNG. WINDOWED ONLY (headless skips both the shots and the probe, by construction). NOT canonical: screenshot utility, title_peek/street_peek's class, deliberately absent from qa/manifest.json. Seed inert: no fight resolves.
